evidence: Substantially refactors BIP32 keypath handling in src/util/bip32.cpp (+150/-28) and src/util/bip32.h (+113/-10) into structured KeyPathElement and KeyPath types.
rationale: Refactors derivation steps in util/bip32 into structured KeyPathElement and KeyPath objects to represent hardening and multipath information cleanly. While an internal improvement, it replaces ad-hoc path parsing with structured primitives.
